content.text: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo states the merger agreement was dated October 20, 2020 in the Executive Summary but the investment memo itself is dated 2020-10-26, creating a timeline inconsistency where the amendment responds to an agreement signed only 6 days prior.", "The memo claims 'All representations and warranties reaffirmed as true and correct (updated through December 31, 2019)' but the amendment is dated October 26, 2020, creating a 10-month gap where current representations cannot be both reaffirmed as true and nearly a year out of date."]}
